name: dsh-plugins
description: Monorepo root for the @dennisrongo dsh plugins. Not published — pnpm needs a manifest at the workspace root.
author: Dennis Rongo

scripts.test: node scripts/check-type-scale.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.// check:type-scale: Every plugin's UI text must sit on the harness's 11/12/13/14/16/20/24 ladder. Each plugin ships its own inline CSS, so nothing structural keeps them together.
scripts.// check:tokens: Every var(--dsw-*) a plugin uses must be a token the harness defines. A misspelt name silently uses its fallback forever and stops following the theme.
scripts.// prepare: Point git at the versioned hooks. .git/hooks is not cloned, so without this a fresh clone silently has no pre-commit gate. Tolerates non-repo checkouts (tarball installs) rather than failing the install.
